seoTitle: Skin Tone Palette Builder for Illustration and Avatars
metaDescription: Generate a range of skin tones, or add shadow and highlight variants to tones you provide. Free, local.
intro: Builds a spread of skin tones or takes your base tones and adds a shadow and a highlight for each.
why:
Illustrators need a believable set of skin colours with matching shading. In OKLCH, shadows get slightly redder and more saturated and highlights lighter and softer, a common painting habit. You control the strength of each.

Tones are generated by a simple rule, not measured from people, and the tool makes no claim about categories. Check them against your artwork and with the people you depict. To sample from a photo, use the Color Picker from Image and paste the colours here.
howTo: Leave the box empty to generate a range, or paste base colours.
Set the shadow and highlight strength.

faq.q: Does it include a photo sampler?
faq.a: Use the Color Picker from Image for that, then paste the colours here.

faq.q: Are the presets standard skin tone scales?
faq.a: No. They are generated by a rule and are not the Fitzpatrick or any other published scale.

faq.q: Can I use them for emoji?
faq.a: They are only colours. Real emoji skin tones are defined by platform artwork.
Zero gives almost no shift, 100 a strong one.
